description: We, class M3-7 have deepened our friendship through multiple events and experiences, including the students who have transferred to our class and the exchange students. Now that we are in the final grade as a junior high student, we have many responsibilities and are required to give our best in school events and exams. When we go up to high school, the SG program ends, which is exactly the reason why we want to give our best to the keyaki festival, our school trip, and the music festival and make our class better. We will continue to make M3-7 a class that will keep providing us memories that would last inside us for a lifetime.
